comment: What the Alight Motion importer does with each effect. action: map (a Kinesis effect), bake (turned into keyframes of the layer), flag (a layer switch) or unsupported (reported, not converted). Unknown ids are reported too.

gaussianblur.note: strength becomes the blur radius in pixels (the unit of Alight's strength is not documented)

invert.note: only when red, green and blue are all inverted

solidcolor.note: colour and alpha; the blend mode is not carried

motionblur4.note: turns on the layer's motion blur; tune and the position/scale/angle switches are not carried

swing2.note: rotation swings between a1 and a2 degrees at freq Hz

oscillate3.note: position moves back and forth by mag pixels along angle at freq Hz

scaleassist.note: its scale multiplies the layer's scale

offset.note: its offset is added to the layer's position; feather and mask are not carried

colorize.reason: the meaning of its tint (three numbers) is not documented, and Kinesis' tint takes a colour

bendwarp.note: a rough stand-in: Kinesis' wave warp, half a wave over the layer's height, with an amplitude that follows the bend angle (sign carried by the phase); the wave lives in composition space, so it does not follow the layer around
